name: Rising Hunter Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Beware of death from above.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, fly or glide speed, Fly 1 rank

Benefits: You grow adept at fighting while flying with certain weapons and gain more options while flying and using this style. You may move up to 5 feet after making an attack while flying as part of a full-round action, provided you remain within the target of your last attack’s reach. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the target is killed, knocked unconscious or loses their threatening reach somehow, you can’t take a 5 foot step. This 5 foot step may be made in a vertical direction if you are on the ground. You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against airborne targets while on the ground, and a +1 bonus on attack rolls against creatures on the ground when in the air.

Special: This feat’s benefit applies to light weapons, ranged weapons, and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
